name: Yiannis Moralis
bio: Yiannis Moralis was an important Greek visual artist and part of the so-called "Generation of the '30s". He is a person who carried weight in many fields and found himself to be equally au courant. Furthermore, he exhibited a strong sense of responsibility when it came to confronting modern day problems. His art is distinct for the esoteric nature of its forms and its capacity and ability to suggest space.

paintings.title: Funeral Composition
paintings.story: Funeral Composition is painting by Yiannis Moralis from 1958.
